name: @siffran/empirica-pi
description: Pi (pi.dev) adapter for the Empirica plugin: registers /empirica and /empirica-status, gates the report_convergence tool/command, and contributes the Empirica skill via resources_discover. Translates Pi lifecycle/tool events to the empirica/v1 contract through an injected transport; the production transport is a JSON stdio bridge to the host-neutral core (ADR-30, ADR-32).
